releases.title: Clean Package Migration, Live TV Rewind, English CC & Safe Search
releases.releaseNotes:
• Clean Package Migration: Migrated package identifier to com.tvdinner, removing all legacy developer tags
• Live TV Rewind: Use remote Left button to step back up to 2 minutes in live stream buffer
• Return to Live: Use remote Right button to advance toward live feed (right button becomes no-op once at live)
• English Closed Captions: Automatic prioritization of English subtitle/CC tracks whenever captions are enabled
• Adult Search Isolation: Adult items are strictly excluded from search results unless an adult category tab is selected

releases.title: Reliable OTA Installer, High-Contrast Search Focus & Remote Enhancements
releases.releaseNotes:
• OTA Update Reliability: Instant package installer launch with cached APK persistence (no re-download required) and unknown app permission handling
• Distinct Version Details: Accurate, version-specific release notes for each release in update dialogs
• High-Contrast Search Focus: Search bars across Live TV, Movies, Series, Music, and Podcasts glow bright cyan/blue when focused
• Music Fast Skipping: Ultra-responsive YouTube track transitions using loadVideoById with zero playback dropouts
• Podcasts Remote Navigation: Press D-Pad UP during podcast playback to immediately jump to the previous episode

releases.title: Live TV Navigation Fix, Backup Portal Failover & Priority Card Art Loading
releases.releaseNotes:
• Live TV: Seamless right navigation from categories into channels across all categories (not just Favorites & History)
• Backup Portal Failover: Plugged in http://vpn.uhd4.top:80 as official failover for bad HTTP status / stream drop recovery
• In-App Stream Reconnect: Added clean socket eviction and Reconnect Stream button so app restart is never needed
• Movies & Series Poster Priority: Proactive preloading of visible cards in viewing order with dedicated fast Coil timeouts
• Settings: Added Primary and Backup Portal URL configuration fields

releases.title: Live TV Navigation, Category Reorder, History, Poster Fixes & Remote Aspect Ratio
releases.releaseNotes:
• Live TV: Smooth D-pad Left & Back navigation directly from preview controls to channel list
• Category Reorder: Moved News Network, Sports Network, Movie Network, Kids Network, Prime, PPV & Events, 4K Relax under Entertainment
• Removed 'All Channels' category
• Added 🕒 Channel History category (last 5 channels watched) with 'Clear History' in Settings
• Enhanced Movies & Series poster loading with automatic TMDB resolution on missing/broken links (no fallback card art)
• Added remote control aspect ratio toggle (Fit / Stretch / Zoom) with on-screen HUD pill overlay
• Removed Next Episode button from series player
• In-app network disconnect detection with automatic stream recovery and socket eviction
• YouTube Music remote navigation: D-Pad Up (Previous) & Down (Next) with on-screen button
• Ambient neon glow halo on focused cards
